task: Find every site in an AL project that still references a third-party dependency's tables, before ripping the dependency out
description: Walks every .al file for external-table reference forms (Record, RecordRef.Open, Database:: literal, TableRelation, SourceTable, RunObject) and groups every site by table with file+line+column. When given -MappingPath (external-table-id/name -> replacement-table-name), also emits the mechanical FixPath at every site. No AL compiler required.
